findings.reason: the reason string is the deliverable itself, written into `CREW_VERBS_OUTSIDE_ORCHESTRATION` as that entry's documented justification, so the plan must state the true reason (a hand-run maintenance surface that neither the timer nor an orchestrator invokes) rather than one the code contradicts.
findings.text: §9 says "The verb is run by the per-user timer that `install_retention_timer` installs, never by an orchestrator", but `render_retention_service_unit` sets `ExecStart` to `<interpreter> -m reckon.crew.gc --apply` (reckon/crew/gc.py:1425-1443), which `install_retention_timer` (gc.py:1468) installs, so the timer runs the module entry point `gc.main`, never the click verb `crew_retention_sweep` (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1558-1616); the verb is an operator-only surface
